title: Bangkok Santol: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaTitle: Bangkok Santol: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaDescription: Bangkok santol is a santol variety from registered by IPB. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Bangkok is a registered santol variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1991. IPB bred it.

heroImage.alt: Young fruit trees planted in straight rows on cleared red soil, the kind of farm where Bangkok santol is grown

blocks.text: Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [santol variety finder](/crop-varieties/santol), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for fruit trees](/land-preparation/fruit-tree-land-preparation).
When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit santol fields most often: [mealybug](/pests/mealybug), [Oriental fruit fly](/pests/oriental-fruit-fly). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A fruit of Bangkok weighs about 220 to 335 g grams, and its shape is round. The flesh is snowy white.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Round, 220 to 335 g, yellow, fairly rough skin, snowy white pulp.
Registered in 1991 with the Philippine Seed Board, with four more accessions in 1992.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: the large santol type, its big seeds are linked to the more serious swallowed seed injuries doctors warn about. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Bangkok santol

Bangkok santol is big and sweet. Pick a selection by fruit size and a thick, sweet rind. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of Bangkok?
items.a: Buy grafted, budded or marcotted trees from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, so you get the true variety. Ask your provincial agriculture office for the nearest one.
